notice: Every case is PLANNED. No case has been run: no game code exists in this workspace and no browser QA was performed. Statuses must not be read as results.

cases.title: Two seats complete join, setup, play, results, rematch
cases.setup: Fresh room, minimum roster for the game.
steps: Create room and join second seat
Configure defaults and start
Play to a natural result
Rematch from results
cases.expected: Each transition lands on the correct screen with no stale snapshot content; rematch mints a new instanceId and all clients remount.
cases.evidence: Playwright snapshot assertions plus screenshots at each screen, desktop and 390px phone.

cases.title: Host change-game and lobby-return mid-session
cases.setup: Completed match, both seats connected.
steps: Host returns room to lobby
Host configures a different game and starts it
Return to lobby again
cases.expected: Dispose runs on every teardown; no previous game audio, timers or input handlers survive; rejected lobby requests leave the current screen intact.
cases.evidence: Console log shows dispose calls; no post-teardown audio or timer callbacks in a 30s observation.

cases.title: End, leave and solo-refresh resume
cases.setup: Active game with two seats.
steps: Host ends the match
One seat leaves the room
Remaining seat refreshes within the linger window and resumes by seat token
cases.expected: End shows results with a reason; leaver's seat is freed; refresher reclaims the same seat by token, same-name join would get a suffix instead.
cases.evidence: Snapshots show seat identity preserved; no duplicate seats after refresh.

cases.title: Late joiner becomes spectator until next start
cases.setup: Game already running.
steps: Third browser joins mid-game with a room code
Current game finishes and host starts again
cases.expected: Mid-game joiner receives watch-only snapshots and their actions are dropped pre-onAction; they join play on the next start.
cases.evidence: Server log shows dropped actions; client shows spectator chrome, then active controls after restart.

cases.title: Host disconnect migrates control without deadlock
cases.setup: Three seats, first seat is host, game in lobby.
steps: Host socket drops
A remaining player configures and starts
cases.expected: hostId migrates to longest-connected player; if no host connected, any connected player may act so the room never deadlocks.
cases.evidence: Room snapshots show new hostId; configure/start accepted from that seat.

cases.title: Kick removes a seat and protects the game
cases.setup: Full small roster in play.
steps: Host kicks one connected seat mid-game
cases.expected: Kicked socket is detached with a reason; roster continues; kicked seat cannot act on the old instanceId.
cases.evidence: State snapshots exclude the kicked seat; their action on stale instanceId is dropped.

cases.title: Stale instance and window guards drop old input
cases.setup: Game running; capture a valid action payload.
steps: Trigger a rematch (new instanceId)
Replay the captured payload with the old i/w values
cases.expected: Room drops the stale payload; no double-apply, no score change, no error visible to other players.
cases.evidence: Server-side drop logged; totals unchanged across the replay.

cases.title: Duplicate action delivery applies once
cases.setup: Game running.
steps: Send the same valid action twice within one tick window
cases.expected: Exactly-once effect (one stroke, one plant, one link); second copy acknowledged without re-applying.
cases.evidence: State diff shows a single application.

cases.title: Old timers never fire into a new phase
cases.setup: Game with a deadline; force a phase change just before expiry.
steps: Start a short deadline
End the phase early via host
Observe past the original expiry
cases.expected: Generation-guarded timers: the stale fire is a no-op; new phase state untouched.
cases.evidence: No phase regression in snapshots after the original expiry passes.

cases.title: Blur, hidden tab and modal release held input
cases.setup: Active play with a held control (aim drag, stick, held key).
steps: Blur the window mid-hold
Hide the document
Open a modal over the playfield
Return
cases.expected: Captures and held keys release on blur/hidden/disposal; no stuck input; modal suspends camera/drag input; return shows a clean idle state.
cases.evidence: Manual pass on desktop plus phone rotation; no phantom movement after return.

cases.title: Offscreen client reaches readiness without paint wait
cases.setup: Two clients, one tab hidden (release-36 Safari lesson).
steps: Start the game with one tab hidden
Observe the hidden client's readiness and the visible client's countdown
cases.expected: Hidden client completes required resources and releases the decorative paint wait; visible client still waits for two-frame paint and first rendered frame before countdown.
cases.evidence: Readiness logs per client; no match-deadline expiry caused by a hidden tab.

cases.title: 150 and 300ms RTT with jitter stay playable
cases.setup: Two clients with throttled RTT profiles (150ms, 300ms + jitter).
steps: Play a full round on each profile
Interrupt snapshot delivery for 3s mid-play
Disconnect one client for 3s and reconnect
cases.expected: Play completes; interruption shows a reconnecting state then resumes by token; 3s drop does not forfeit the seat or corrupt totals.
cases.evidence: Throttled-network Playwright runs; snapshot continuity across the gap.

cases.title: Equal scores share rank; zero-score results read cleanly
cases.setup: Scripted all-tied and scoreless finishes per game.
steps: Force an all-tied final
Force a zero-score final
cases.expected: Tied players share the rank with tie copy; scoreless finals show the honest scoreless message, never an empty or broken board.
cases.evidence: Screenshots of both results screens per game.

cases.title: Five layout states keep the playfield clear
cases.setup: One playable build per game.
steps: Render desktop, portrait phone, landscape phone, tablet, compact embed widths
Open every drawer and disclosure at the narrowest width
cases.expected: Centre and lower-middle playfield stay clear; secondary info collapses to disclosures; persistent HUD stays near 20-25% of viewport on desktop; safe-area insets respected.
cases.evidence: Screenshots at all five widths per game; HUD-coverage estimate recorded.

cases.title: Touch-capable laptop keeps both input paths
cases.setup: Touch-capable laptop browser.
steps: Play using keyboard/mouse only
Play using touch only
cases.expected: Both paths work in the same session; touch controls appear by capability, keyboard shortcuts remain active.
cases.evidence: Physical-device pass; cannot be proven by desktop resize.

cases.title: WebGL context loss and asset failure recover
cases.setup: Playable build with critical/optional asset manifest.
steps: Force a WebGL context loss mid-play
Block an optional asset and reload
Block a critical asset and reload
cases.expected: Context loss shows a recovery state and restores without a score change; missing optional asset degrades dressing only; missing critical asset blocks countdown with a named reason, never a frozen frame.
cases.evidence: Forced-loss run plus blocked-request runs; countdown gating logged.

cases.title: Giggle Meet panel coexists with every layout
cases.setup: Embedded room with a live call alongside play.
steps: Play one round with floating tiles (golf/bomb) and adjacent call (repairs)
Collapse and expand the media panel mid-play
cases.expected: Call never covers the active control; collapsing the panel never remounts or resets play; game opens no second capture.
cases.evidence: Embedded-mode screenshots; getUserMedia call count stays at the Meet layer only.

cases.title: First-play payload, cold start and frame budgets
cases.setup: Production-shaped build on 10Mbps/100ms profile and a declared midrange phone.
steps: Measure compressed first-play bytes
Time to usable playfield with visible loading
Record p95 frame intervals on desktop and phone plus a 10-minute thermal run
cases.expected: Payload <= 4MB; playfield <= 5s; desktop p95 <= 20ms, phone p95 <= 36ms; no thermal collapse; local feedback <= 50ms with server ack timed separately.
cases.evidence: Measurement logs per device; targets are proposed, results recorded as observed.

cases.title: Rest threshold decides roll vs stop server-side
cases.setup: Ball rolling near the 0.35 m/s boundary on the 60 Hz step.
steps: Roll balls at just above and just below threshold speeds
Attempt a second shot during roll and after rest
cases.expected: Below-threshold-for-0.5s balls accept input; rolling balls reject with 'ball rolling', never queue; renderer prediction never overrides the server verdict.
cases.evidence: Server step logs vs client presentation; second-shot-during-roll rejected in snapshots.

cases.title: High-speed cup contact lips out
cases.setup: Ball aimed at cup above 4.5 m/s and below it.
steps: Putt hot at the cup
Putt soft at the cup
cases.expected: Hot putt shows a rim bounce and stays live; soft putt drops; both outcomes come from the server.
cases.evidence: Slow-review screenshots plus server outcome log.

cases.title: Cap, deadline and out-of-bounds end a hole fairly
cases.setup: Player at 7 strokes; hole deadline near expiry; ball near the edge.
steps: Take an 8th stroke
Let the deadline expire mid-roll for another player
Knock a ball out of bounds
cases.expected: Cap records cap+1 and spectates; deadline records cap+1 for unholed balls with recap copy; OB resets to last rest +1 stroke.
cases.evidence: Recap snapshots show correct strokes and reasons.

cases.title: Eight simultaneous balls stay readable and independent
cases.setup: Full 8-seat room on Banker's Garden.
steps: All players putt within the same second
One player aims while seven balls roll
cases.expected: No physical interaction between balls; every ball identifiable by pattern + colour; aiming player sees no crowd occlusion; camera stays stable while aiming.
cases.evidence: 8-client screenshot during mass putt; aim-drift measurement while others roll.

cases.title: Early finisher spectates without affecting play
cases.setup: One player holes out while others still putt.
steps: Holed player follows a friend's ball
Holed player attempts shot input
cases.expected: Follow is view-only; any shot input from a holed player is rejected; remaining players unaffected.
cases.evidence: Snapshot shows follow target change with no state mutation.

cases.title: Aim gesture cancels safely by drag-back and Esc
cases.setup: Ball at rest, aiming.
steps: Drag out then drag back to the ball and release
Aim and press Esc
Release outside the arena
cases.expected: All three cancel with zero strokes charged and the ball undisturbed; specified cancel semantics, no accidental putts.
cases.evidence: Stroke count unchanged across all three cancels on desktop and touch.

cases.title: First-time player putts within 20 seconds and names the bank
cases.setup: Greybox Banker's Garden, first-time player, no coaching.
steps: Open the hole
Observe time to first putt
Ask what the risky route is after two holes
cases.expected: First putt inside 20s; player can describe the bank option; misunderstandings recorded verbatim.
cases.evidence: Human-gate notes: timings, quotes, voluntary rematch or not.

cases.title: Neither screen solves the Crossover Box alone
cases.setup: Teaching attempt; isolate each role's information.
steps: Pilot attempts three links using only the terminal view
Engineer attempts three links using only the legend view
cases.expected: Neither succeeds without the other screen's content; success requires at least one exchanged message per link.
cases.evidence: Two solo-attempt transcripts showing failure points; paired transcript showing the exchange.

cases.title: Six-player crew gives everyone owned work
cases.setup: Full 6-seat crew on the timed rescue.
steps: Play the rescue with all six
Ask each player what they owned
cases.expected: Pilot, co-pilot rhythm reading, and four clue owners each name a decision only they made; nobody reports holding scraps.
cases.evidence: Post-mission ownership interviews plus action log per seat.

cases.title: Text and pings alone complete the mission at parity
cases.setup: Voice muted for the whole crew.
steps: Complete the teaching attempt using only text and the ping palette
Time it against a voice crew baseline
cases.expected: Mission completes; no voice-only information exists; ping palette covers confirm/deny/rhythm/legend requests.
cases.evidence: Text-only transcript of a completed mission; parity checklist vs voice run.

cases.title: Wrong breakers forgive; expiry loses cleanly with rotation
cases.setup: Teaching attempt, then timed rescue.
steps: Throw two wrong breakers
Let the timed rescue expire with systems dark
cases.expected: Amber flash + buzz, no score damage, one bounded hint offered; expiry shows 'Ship cold. Retry?' with role rotation offered.
cases.evidence: Screenshots of feedback and loss screens; hint text bounded to the mission.

cases.title: Clue owner disconnect re-deals privately and predictably
cases.setup: Four-player rescue, legend owner drops mid-mission.
steps: Disconnect the legend owner's socket
Observe reassignment
Reconnect the owner by seat token
cases.expected: Clue family re-deals to a connected owner within one snapshot with a 'Rerouted' notice; private sheets never leak into spectator/report/public views; token reconnect restores the sheet.
cases.evidence: Per-seat view() diffs proving no leak; reconnect snapshot restores ownership.

cases.title: First-time text-only crew finishes teaching in 6 minutes
cases.setup: Two first-time players, voice muted, no coaching.
steps: Start the teaching attempt
Record misunderstandings and completion time
cases.expected: Completion within 6 minutes; crew reports the rescue moment, not confusion about controls; any screenshot-of-both-screens shortcut attempt is caught and fails.
cases.evidence: Human-gate notes with timings and quotes.

cases.title: Fuse, arms, blocking and chain order behave exactly
cases.setup: Scripted arena: wall, cover, two bombs in line.
steps: Plant and time the fuse
Detonate with cover in an arm path
Catch the second bomb in the first blast
cases.expected: Fuse 2.5s; arms reach 3 cells, blocked by walls, cover destroyed and stops the arm; chained bomb fires immediately in plant order with its own arms.
cases.evidence: Tick-level server log matched to rendered frames.

cases.title: Planter re-entry, simultaneous deaths and disconnect ghosts
cases.setup: Arena with planted bombs and scripted final exchanges.
steps: Planter leaves then re-enters their bomb cell
Kill the last two players in the same tick
Disconnect a living player mid-round
cases.expected: Re-entry rejected (walkable only until leaving); simultaneous final deaths draw the round; disconnected avatar is a harmless non-blocking ghost resumable by token.
cases.evidence: Server occupancy log; draw verdict screenshot; ghost non-interaction proven by blast passing through.

cases.title: No seed spawns unavoidable death; results wait for settle
cases.setup: Seed sweep plus a live round ending in chained blasts.
steps: Generate 500 arenas and check 2-tile escape paths
End a round mid-chain and watch the verdict timing
cases.expected: Every seed offers an escape path before the first plant; verdict appears only after the last explosion visibly settles.
cases.evidence: Seed-sweep log with zero rejections missed; verdict timing vs last blast frame.

cases.title: Provisional movement vs authoritative confirmation never fakes escape
cases.setup: 300ms RTT client near a live blast.
steps: Move out of a blast line at the last moment
Plant on an occupied cell
Multi-touch move plus plant together
cases.expected: Provisional steps render distinctly from confirmed ones; no rendered escape is later reversed into death; rejected plants snap back with a reason; multi-touch registers both intents.
cases.evidence: Side-by-side provisional/confirmed rendering check; plant-reject copy screenshot.

cases.title: Blocked UI, modal and blur cannot strand or misfire input
cases.setup: Round in progress.
steps: Plant with a modal open
Blur mid-move
Rotate the phone mid-round
cases.expected: Blocked/modal input is refused with feedback, never silently applied; blur and rotation cancel gestures; no bomb plants from a cancelled orbit or pinch.
cases.evidence: Device pass; input log shows cancels, not ghost plants.

cases.title: Every death reads as the player's fault; waiting stays short
cases.setup: Four-player greybox arena, first-time players.
steps: Play three rounds
Ask each eliminated player why they died
Time eliminated-player waits and count rematches
cases.expected: Unanimous 'my fault' on deaths; waits rarely exceed 30s; players voluntarily rematch; any reversed-escape report fails the input contract.
cases.evidence: Human-gate notes: death quotes, wait timings, rematch rate.

cases.title: Event audio is comfortable, ducked and disposed
cases.setup: Each game with sound on beside a call.
steps: Trigger each gameplay event sound
Dispose the view and listen for 15s
cases.expected: Sounds audible but comfortable, ducked around conversation, fully stopped on disposal; no navigation or homepage sounds exist.
cases.evidence: Heard-audio check on device; post-dispose silence observed, not assumed.

cases.title: Reduced motion preserves all game information
cases.setup: prefers-reduced-motion enabled, each game mid-play.
steps: Enable reduced motion
Trigger aim, blast, repair-success and countdown states
cases.expected: No flashing/shaking; blast danger, aim direction, repair state and deadlines remain fully readable through static cues.
cases.evidence: Screenshots of each state under reduced motion.

cases.title: Selected kit files meet the shipping bar
cases.setup: Chosen per-file shortlist from the three Kenney kits plus original meshes.
steps: Record source URL and CC0 license per file
Check units, pivots, materials and collision proxies
Measure compressed bytes, decode cost and mobile LOD behaviour
cases.expected: Every shipped file has a license line; consistent units/pivots; explicit proxies where physics touches; critical vs optional manifests honoured; no runtime primitive model-building during attacks.
cases.evidence: Asset ledger with per-file rows; measurement logs.
